dualBuild: While Ego is active, a dual build crossfades smoothly back and forth between its main and secondary archetype crests. Archetypes in the same family share one crest, so a same-family build shows one crest and does not crossfade.

egoMode.release: NEXT UPDATE, together with the crests. Not part of the current work.
egoMode.change: Ego mode now boosts only the attributes in the player's own archetype categories.
egoMode.rule: FINAL (user decision). Ego gives point pools split EVENLY across the archetype's attributes (primary and secondary attributes both count). Dual build: the main archetype's pool is 8 points, the secondary archetype's pool is 5 points. Pure build: one pool of 10 points. An attribute in both archetypes gets points from both pools. Ratings never pass 99.
egoMode.rounding: Proposal, confirm with the user: when a pool does not divide evenly, give the leftover points one each to the archetype's primary attributes first.

archetypeModel: Five archetypes (roadmap, Nov 8): Sharpshooter/Stretch, Lockdown/Rim Protector, Slasher/Post, Playmaker, Shot creator. The crest follows the name the player sees: Slasher uses the bolt crest at PG/SG/SF and the mailbox crest when it shows as Post at PF/C (user decision, Nov 9).
